en.headline: Chan welcomes return of 11 Skies to the Airport Authority
en.dek: The transport chief said on Saturday the authority would rename and reposition the airport commercial project after New World hands it back next April.
body: Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said on Saturday the government welcomed an agreement for New World Development to return the 11 Skies project at the airport to the Airport Authority, and expected the site to be repositioned as a higher-end tourism landmark.

Speaking on a radio programme, Chan said the two sides had reached an agreement on commercial and contractual principles. New World is to hand the project back at no charge on 1 April next year and pay about HK$3.3 billion in compensation and works costs, according to accounts of the deal reported by local outlets.

Chan said the authority would set up a dedicated subsidiary and team to take over the project, rename it and reset its direction. She said the aim was to move it beyond a mainly office-and-retail property and align it with the Airport City plan, including the second passenger terminal expected to open at the end of 2027 and the second phase of AsiaWorld-Expo due in 2028.

The complex covers more than 3.8 million square feet. The Airport Authority has previously said most facilities are now expected to open in 2028, after directors described ending the long contract as a way to avoid a drawn-out dispute.

zh.headline: 陳美寶樂見11 SKIES交還機管局 將重新定位
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局局長周六表示，新世界明年四月把機場商業項目交還機管局後，當局會重新命名及定位，朝高階旅遊地標發展。
body: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶周六表示，政府樂見新世界發展與香港機場管理局就11 SKIES達成安排，期望項目交還後轉型為高階旅遊體驗地標。
陳美寶在電台節目說，雙方按商業及合約精神達成協議。據本地媒體引述有關安排，新世界將於明年4月1日無償把項目交還機管局營運，並支付共約33億元補償及工程費用。
她說，機管局會成立專責附屬公司及團隊接管，並為項目重新定位及重新命名，由原本以寫字樓及零售為主，配合機場城市規劃。相關配套包括預計2027年年底啟用的二號客運大樓，以及2028年落成的亞洲國際博覽館第二期。
11 SKIES總樓面逾380萬平方呎。機管局較早時表示，大部分設施現時預計2028年開幕，董事形容提前終止近50年合約，是為避免曠日持久的爭議。
